name: White Elephant
source:
It's Christmas eve, and you're back home for the most tedious task of the year; catching up with your family. Who said holidays were supposed to be relaxing?

[From [url=https://saiyohara.itch.io/white-elephant]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
圣诞节前夕，你回到家开始一年中最乏味的任务；与家人团聚。谁说假期就应该轻松愉快？
